trait.name: Water Breathing
entries: The octopus can breathe only underwater. It can hold its breath for 1 hour outside water.

trait.name: Hold Breath
entries: While out of water, the octopus can hold its breath for 1 hour.

trait.name: Underwater Camouflage
entries: The octopus has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made while underwater.

action.name: Tentacles
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 10 ft. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Grappled|SRD52} condition (escape {@dc 13}) from all eight tentacles. While {@condition Grappled|SRD52}, the target has the {@condition Restrained|SRD52} condition.

reaction.name: Ink Cloud (1/Day)
entries: {@actTrigger} The octopus takes damage while underwater. {@actResponse} The octopus releases ink that fills a 10-foot {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Cube} centered on itself, and the octopus moves up to its {@variantrule Swim Speed|SRD52}. The {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Cube} is {@variantrule Heavily Obscured|SRD52} for 1 minute or until a strong current or similar effect disperses the ink.
